text: Based on the tool output, no deforestation occurred on the asset after 2020. The assessment status is "NOT_DETECTED," indicating that no tree-cover loss event of 0.5 hectares or more was detected within the asset between 2021 and 2025. The observations confirm that there was no forest in 2020 and no significant tree-cover loss events occurred after the baseline date of December 31, 2020. The data used is from reliable sources such as Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020, ensuring the accuracy of the assessment.
